<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Outlook:</strong> The RBI faces mounting pressure to tighten monetary policy to combat rising inflation and maintain currency stability following recent global interest rate hikes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
